"""Post-graph per-field judge package.

Public surface for the per-field judge loop, its result types, and client
normalization. The loop adapts raw ``BaseChatModel`` clients through the
same ``judge_single_action_result`` chain the in-graph judge uses, and
reports unavailable judging explicitly via ``JUDGE_SKIPPED``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .clients import (
    ModelJudgeClient,
    SupportsJudgeSingleAction,
    judge_client_from,
)
from .loop import JudgeLoopDeps, run_per_field_judge_loop
from .results import JudgeFieldResult, JudgeLoopResult
from .types import (
    INTERRUPT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
    STATUS_QUEUE_POLL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    FreeformGuardrailResult,
    JudgeCapabilities,
    PreexistingCorrectionResult,
    ProfileExtractionResult,
)

__all__ = [
    "FreeformGuardrailResult",
    "INTERRUPT_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS",
    "JudgeCapabilities",
    "JudgeFieldResult",
    "JudgeLoopDeps",
    "JudgeLoopResult",
    "ModelJudgeClient",
    "PreexistingCorrectionResult",
    "ProfileExtractionResult",
    "STATUS_QUEUE_POLL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
    "SupportsJudgeSingleAction",
    "judge_client_from",
    "run_per_field_judge_loop",
]
